en.headline: Hong Kong paddlers claim silver and bronze at Asian Para Games
en.dek: Chiu Kan-shan and Wong Yue-ching took silver in women's doubles while Ho Ka-sing and Wong Chi-yin secured bronze in men's doubles in Nagoya on Friday.
body: Hong Kong table tennis athletes added two medals at the Asian Para Games in Nagoya on Friday. Chiu Kan-shan and Wong Yue-ching claimed silver in the women's doubles class WD14 event after losing to China's Huang Wenjuan and Liu Xiaowu.

The Chinese pair won in straight games 5-11, 8-11, 8-11 in 23 minutes. In the men's doubles class MD18, Ho Ka-sing and Wong Chi-yin took bronze after falling 1-3 to China's Lian Hao and Zhao Shuai in the semi-finals.
The SAR pair took the second game 11-7 after losing the first 8-11 but could not sustain the momentum, dropping the next two. Hong Kong has continued to accumulate medals across sports at the Games.

zh.headline: 港隊乒乓選手於亞殘運再添銀銅牌
zh.dek: 趙君山與黃宇晴在女子雙打奪銀，何嘉成與黃志賢在男子雙打獲銅，賽事周五在名古屋舉行。
body: 香港乒乓選手周五在名古屋亞殘運再添兩面獎牌。趙君山與黃宇晴在女子雙打WD14級別奪得銀牌，不敵中國的黃文娟與劉曉武。
中國組合以5-11、8-11、8-11直落三局在23分鐘內獲勝。男子雙打MD18級別方面，何嘉成與黃志賢在半決賽以1-3不敵中國的連浩與趙帥，奪得銅牌。
港隊組合在首局8-11落後後，次局以11-7扳平，但未能保持優勢，其後兩局失利。香港代表團在多個項目持續累積獎牌。
